“With a PDUFA goal date of March 16, 2027, we believe we have a clear path to making Anaphylm available to patients and caregivers, if approved,” said Daniel Barber, President and Chief Executive Officer of Aquestive.
The FDA acknowledged the resubmission as complete, classified it as a Class 2 response and assigned a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) goal date of March 16, 2027.

Final FDA approval for patients twelve years of age and older is subject to expiration of the orphan drug exclusivity for Valtoco® on January 10, 2027, and final FDA action, with a PDUFA goal date of March 23, 2027.
The Company has also submitted a Type 9 NDA seeking to add patients six to eleven years of age to the label, with a PDUFA goal date of March 29, 2027.

These forward-looking statements include, but are not limited to, statements regarding the FDA’s review of the accepted Class 2 resubmission of the NDA for Anaphylm™ (dibutepinephrine) sublingual film and potential approval by the March 16, 2027 PDUFA goal date; the Company’s commercial launch strategy, launch readiness and potential launch of Anaphylm, if approved; potential international regulatory submissions and marketing authorizations for Anaphylm, including the anticipated timing of submissions in Canada and the European Union; the potential for Anaphylm, if approved, to be the first and only oral rescue medication for the treatment of severe allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis; the design, timing, and conduct of clinical studies for AQST-108 (epinephrine) topical gel, data and potential indications, and the advancement of the AdrenaVerse™ platform; the timing and outcome of FDA review of Libervant® (diazepam) buccal film, including potential final approval, label expansion and commercial availability; Eton Pharmaceuticals’ commercialization of Libervant; the potential receipt by Aquestive of contingent milestone and royalty payments; Aquestive’s manufacture and supply of Libervant; the Company’s 2026 financial outlook, liquidity, cash requirements, funding and operating results; and other statements that are not historical facts.
